verdict.rationale: Cerebras advertises full OpenAI API compatibility (docs-3, docs-4) and has a models catalog page (docs-21, docs-11, docs-18) that lists available models, which implies a /v1/models-style listing is likely present given OpenAI parity. However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents a GET /v1/models endpoint, its response schema, or shows an agent calling it programmatically, and a probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s across all candidate paths. Missing for 10: explicit endpoint documentation for GET /v1/models, a sample request/response, and any first-party or community confirmation of programmatic catalog enumeration.
